title: Why the plan has prices on it
summary: Every commitment in the plan comes with a cost and a measure. Here is why, and where the numbers came from.
body:
When I started knocking on doors, people did not ask what I believed. They asked what it would cost, and how they would know it happened.

So every item in the plan has three parts: what I will do, what it costs, and how you will know it worked. The numbers come from the county's own budget documents, the state bridge aid tables and the 2023 flood study contract. Where we estimated, it says so.

title: The bridge list, as far as we can see it
summary: We asked for the county's bridge inspection scores in September. Here is what we got back and what is still missing.
body: The county road office sent scores for 51 of the 64 county bridges. Thirteen are missing, including two on the Pell Orchard detour. We have asked again.

title: Ledger forum moved to Hollin Cross High School
summary: The January 14 forum has a bigger room. Doors at 6:30.
body: The Wrenfield Ledger has moved its January 14 candidate forum to the Hollin Cross High School auditorium. Doors open at 6:30 pm; the forum starts at 7.

title: This weekend's turf: Hollin Cross and Tannery Flats
summary: Two launches Saturday. What to say about the flood study, and what not to promise.
body:
Saturday we launch from the Grange at ten. Tannery Flats packets go out with Marisol at the 2 pm porch coffee.

On the flood study: say that Noor will publish it. Do not promise a buyout amount or a date; nobody has seen the study yet, including us.

title: Door script, version 3
summary: Shorter opening, and lead with the issue the precinct cares about most.
body:
Open with your name and that you are a neighbor. Then one line: in Pell Orchard and Sexton Ridge lead with the bridge; in Tannery Flats the flood study; in Quillon Mills and Marrow Hill the health office hours.

Ask one question and listen. Write down what they said, not what you think it means.

title: Rides to early voting
summary: We will need twelve drivers for the two early-voting Saturdays.
body: Sign up with your shift lead. Drivers need a valid license and insurance on file with the office. No campaign material in the car on the way to the polls.

title: Precinct numbers after the October push
summary: Marrow Hill and Sexton Ridge are behind on doors. Proposal: move two Saturday crews.
body: We are at 4,952 of 9,300 door goals district-wide. Marrow Hill is at 39 percent and Sexton Ridge at 34. Proposal: move the two Quillon Mills crews to Marrow Hill for three Saturdays, and add a driver pairing on the ridge.

title: Ledger forum prep: the gravel pit question
summary: Expect a follow-up on the County Road 14 pit. Our answer stays the same: not with this truck route.
body: Keep the answer to the truck route and school hours. Do not speculate on the operator's plans. If asked about campaign contributions from the operator: there are none, and that is on file.
